task: Fix PR #3550 round-two adversarial review findings for orphan-ref validator issue #3456.

events.content: Merged origin/main into fix/3456-orphan-ref-tests-coverage after live-state guard showed main moved.

Fixed scanner fail-open paths: truncation is incomplete, active findings sort before baselined findings, broken symlinks are incomplete, BOM encodings decode, malformed UTF-8 is incomplete, and permission failures exit 4.
Fixed suppression accounting so file-scope ignores count skipped files and report suppressed references through the same extraction candidate pipeline.
Expanded default scope through git ls-files over tracked text roots and corrected issue #3556 to describe the real default-scope and Python-literal gaps.
Hardened tests with positive extraction evidence and mutation proof for the round-two survivor set.
Pre-push first failed on portability ratchet drift, then scanner constants and tests were adjusted to avoid new upstream path refs.
